delivery.qaSummary: IT 服务台端到端验收通过：员工提交工单（含优先级与截图）、服务台按姓名分派且按原值回填优先级、工程师记录处理过程与解决办法、员工退回继续处理、再次解决并确认关闭均实测成功。上一轮四个缺陷已全部修复：分派弹窗 Priority/Category 按工单原值回填且确认后 Low 不再被静默改为 Medium；工程师下拉显示姓名而非内部 ID；创建/分派/解决/退回/关闭后列表状态即时刷新；corrupt.png 与 unsupported.exe 均给出明确错误反馈。角色可见范围正确（员工仅本人、工程师仅本人被分派、服务台全部），分派与结果通知可点击进入工单，超 24 小时催办服务台，首页展示待分派/超时/工程师工作量，控制台无异常。

checks.title:
我是IT服务台负责人，需要一个公司内部报修系统。员工提交问题、紧急程度和截图，服务台分派给工程师，工程师记录处理过程和解决办法，员工确认解决后关闭；仍未解决可以退回继续处理。

员工只看自己的工单，工程师只处理分派给自己的工单，服务台查看全部。新分派和处理结果及时通知相关人员，点击通知可以进入对应工单；超过24小时未解决时提醒服务台。首页展示待分派、超时工单和各工程师的工作量。
checks.criterion:
我是IT服务台负责人，需要一个公司内部报修系统。员工提交问题、紧急程度和截图，服务台分派给工程师，工程师记录处理过程和解决办法，员工确认解决后关闭；仍未解决可以退回继续处理。

员工只看自己的工单，工程师只处理分派给自己的工单，服务台查看全部。新分派和处理结果及时通知相关人员，点击通知可以进入对应工单；超过24小时未解决时提醒服务台。首页展示待分派、超时工单和各工程师的工作量。
actions: 以服务台负责人账号登录（nocobase、dave），查看首页统计、超时催办与工程师工作量，并浏览全部工单。
以员工 alice 登录，在 /main/tickets/new 填写标题、描述、Priority=Low、Category=hardware 并上传固定样例 sample.png 提交成功；随后分别上传 corrupt.png 与 unsupported.exe 验证附件校验反馈。
以服务台 dave 登录，打开新建 Low 工单点击 Assign：核对 Priority/Category 是否按工单原值回填、Assignee 是否显示姓名；选择 Bob Li 后不改优先级直接确认，再返回列表核对状态刷新。
以工程师 bob 登录，确认列表仅含分派给 Bob 的工单；直接打开 Carol 的工单确认不可见；对本人工单执行 Start processing、添加处理过程评论、Record a resolution 填写解决办法。
以员工 alice 登录，在收件箱查看被分派/正在处理/已解决通知并点击进入对应工单；对工单执行 Return for further processing 并填写退回原因。
再次以 bob 登录对该工单二次记录解决办法；再以 alice 登录点击 Confirm and close，并在列表核对状态刷新。
以 dave 登录收件箱查看超 24 小时催办提醒并点击通知进入对应工单；检查浏览器控制台与页面错误。
evidence: 主流程完整走通两次：员工提交（含优先级与 sample.png 截图）→ 服务台分派 → 工程师记录处理过程与解决办法 → 员工退回继续处理 → 工程师再次解决 → 员工确认关闭，最终详情与列表均为 Closed。
分派回填修复：Assign 弹窗对 Low 工单显示 Priority=Low、Category=hardware（不再默认 medium）；选择 Bob Li 且不改优先级确认后工单仍为 Low，未发生静默改值。
分派显示修复：Assignee 下拉显示 Bob Li / Carol Wang 姓名，选择后显示 Bob Li，不再显示内部用户 ID。
列表刷新修复：创建、分派、解决、退回、关闭后工单列表状态即时更新（新建工单提交后立即显示 Submitted，分派后立即 Assigned，关闭后立即 Closed），无需整页刷新。
附件校验修复：corrupt.png 提示“That file is not a valid image. Attach a PNG, JPG, GIF, WebP or BMP screenshot.”；unsupported.exe 提示“File type is not allowed.”，均不再被接受或静默忽略。
角色可见范围：alice 工单列表只包含其本人上报的工单；bob 仅看到分派给 Bob 的工单，直接打开 Carol 的工单返回“Ticket not found … not visible to your role”；dave 看到全部工单。注册的新用户无角色，进入帮助台提示“You do not have access to the help desk.”。
通知：alice 收到被分派/正在处理/已解决通知，bob 收到分派给本人/退回/确认关闭通知；点击通知标题均进入对应工单详情。
超时提醒：dave 收件箱出现“Ticket waiting too long：Meeting room projector flickers (urgent priority) has been unresolved for over 24 hours.”，点击可进入该工单。
首页：服务台首页展示 Awaiting assignment、Overdue、Open、Resolved、Total 与 Engineer workload（Bob Li、Carol Wang 各自 open 数）及 Recent tickets，数字随状态流转更新。
控制台与页面未出现 Something went wrong、空白页或未处理异常。附加观察：创建入口对所有角色可见，但仅员工角色可提交，非员工提交由服务端返回 403 并显示受控提示；需求仅要求员工提交，故仅记为界面提示一致性小观察，不影响本项结论。

rawRetro.summary: Repaired the help-desk application: after admin login the sidebar held only Home and the body was the built-in AI-builder page. The workspace branches for tickets/help-desk never existed; the feature was rebuilt end to end — lifecycle-backed tickets, role-scoped authorization, notification targets, an overdue reminder job, sample data, API routes, client pages and navigation. Also fixed the several NocoBase 3 contract mismatches found while verifying it (composite authorization, id generation, response envelope, cookie-write origin, permission-set scopes, overdue accounting). A follow-up repair fixed four observed help-desk defects: the assign dialog now prefills the ticket priority and category, selects render translated labels instead of raw values, the ticket list refreshes after a transition, and screenshot uploads validate image content and report unsupported or corrupt files.

improvements.title: Repository `select` expects a builder, not a string array
improvements.detail: `database.repository<T>().findMany({ select: ['subjectId'] })` compiled against the wrong shape: RepositorySelect is `SelectAst | ((select: SelectBuilder) => AnySelectBuilder)`. Hand-written code that guesses the older array form fails the app's typecheck although ESLint and Prettier stay green.
improvements.suggestedChange: When querying with a projection, use `select: (select) => select.fields(...)` as the installed @nocobase/app-plugin-* packages do, or add a small typed helper for repeated projections.

improvements.title: Composite decisions are conditional; use authorize, not require
improvements.detail: A composite resource action always composes to `effect: conditional`. `authz.require` accepts only `permit` and therefore throws for any composite action, including one the caller is fully granted. The working pattern reads the decision and the row policy from `decision.conditions.database.<collection>`.
improvements.suggestedChange: Document the conditional-composite contract next to `require` in the authorization Skill, or make `require` accept a conditional decision that carries database conditions.

improvements.title: ApiClient.request resolves the whole envelope
improvements.detail: Unlike many fetch wrappers, `ApiClient.request` resolves the parsed JSON envelope `{ data, meta? }`. A caller that types the return as the payload compiles and then reads `undefined`, which presents as a blank page rather than an error.
improvements.suggestedChange: In the client Skill, show the envelope in the first example and state that success bodies are `{ data }`; consider a typed `requestData` helper that unwraps it.

improvements.title: NocoBase 3 does not generate row ids
improvements.detail: A `uuid('id').primary().notNull()` column has no default and the repository inserts only the values it is given, so an application-owned table must supply `id: randomUUID()` on every insert. The failure mode is a raw NOT NULL constraint.
improvements.suggestedChange: State the rule in the migrations reference and, where possible, have the Collection Builder add a uuid default so hand-written collections behave like the built-ins.

improvements.title: Cookie writes fail closed without a trusted origin
improvements.detail: Better Auth rejects cookie-authenticated writes unless the request Origin is trusted, and trusted origins come from `auth.trustedOrigins` plus the base URL (`APP_PUBLIC_ORIGIN`). Without either, reads work and writes return 403 INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN, which is easy to misdiagnose as a permission bug.
improvements.suggestedChange: Have the authentication Skill and the template default trusted origins from the request origin when `app.publicOrigin` is unset, or warn at startup that browser writes will fail.

improvements.title: A permission-set action without a scope silently falls back to the default
improvements.detail: Granting `comment` without a data scope gives the action its default scope (the reporter), so an engineer or service-desk grant appears to succeed yet the role cannot act on the tickets it should.
improvements.suggestedChange: Warn when a granted action relies on the default scope, since that is rarely what a non-owner role intends.

improvements.title: Application providers must tolerate an optional-plugin runtime
improvements.detail: The template composition tests start the whole runtime twice: once with an empty plugin list (createTestApp) and once against a real database with no business migrations (createEmbeddedServer). An application-owned provider registered from server/providers/index.ts is constructed in both, so resolving a built-in plugin token or querying a business collection at register()/start() time fails tests the application did not touch. The failure looks like a template regression.
improvements.suggestedChange: State in the application-development Skill that server/providers/index.ts entries must be dormant when their optional plugin or their own migration is absent, and show the `container.has(token)` / `collections().get(name)` guards in the provider example.

problems.title: server/helpdesk/notifications.ts select array rejected by repository type
problems.symptom: tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit failed with TS2769: No overload matches this call for `select: ['subjectId']` on the authorizationPermissionSetAssignments repository.
problems.rootCause: The repository input contract models `select` as a SelectAst or a builder callback returning AnySelectBuilder, not as a readonly string array of field names.
problems.resolution: Replaced `select: ['subjectId']` with `select: (select) => select.fields('subjectId')` in `serviceDeskUserIds()`, matching the pattern used by @nocobase/app-plugin-authorization and authentication. Re-ran all three tsc projects, Prettier, and ESLint on the file; all pass.

problems.title: Home page and every business route answered with the built-in AI-builder page
problems.symptom: After signing in as admin the sidebar contained only Home, the body rendered the generic NocoBase AI-builder page, /main/tickets, /main/helpdesk, /main/service-desk and /main/requests all redirected to /main, and /main/inbox showed "Nothing here". No ticket UI or API existed at all.
problems.rootCause: The help-desk feature had never been built; the application shipped only the template homepage. The navigation tree is derived from declared routes, so with no ticket route there was no menu entry and the SPA fallback rendered home for every unknown path.
problems.resolution: Built the feature: migration 202610200001_create_helpdesk.ts; server/helpdesk/* (lifecycle, resources, notifications, service, provisioning); server/providers/helpdesk.ts and server/routes/helpdesk.ts; client/pages/tickets/* and client/pages/home/index.tsx; routes and navigation in client/routes.ts; locales and tests. Verified through the browser that the service desk sees the Help desk menu and list, an engineer sees only assigned tickets, and an employee can submit a ticket.

problems.title: tickets.id NOT NULL — every ticket insert failed
problems.symptom: POST /tickets and provisioning failed with a NOT NULL constraint on tickets.id; no ticket row could be created.
problems.rootCause: NocoBase 3 does not auto-generate row ids. The migration declares `uuid('id').primary().notNull()` with no default, and the @nocobase/db repository inserts exactly the values it is given. Built-in collections supply their own ids (better-auth, the notification plugin and @nocobase/app-plugin-file all call randomUUID()).
problems.resolution: Every insert supplies `id: randomUUID()` — in HelpdeskService.create, HelpdeskService.comment and the sample tickets in provision.ts. Verified tickets and comments persist with generated uuids.

problems.title: Assigning a ticket left the assignee blank and workload at zero
problems.symptom: After the service desk assigned a ticket the detail showed no assignee name, and the per-engineer workload counters stayed at zero.
problems.rootCause: The assign transition input carried only `assigneeId`; the workload summary read `assigneeName`, and the provisioning path fired the transition directly (bypassing HelpdeskService) without passing a name at all.
problems.resolution: Resolve the engineer name before firing: assign passes `{ assigneeId, assigneeName }`, and provision.ts stores `{ id, name }` per user. The workload summary groups by `assigneeId` and displays `assigneeName`.

problems.title: Overdue count reset whenever the reminder fired
problems.symptom: A ticket older than 24 hours dropped out of the overdue dashboard stat as soon as the overdue reminder ran.
problems.rootCause: The overdue counter compared `statusChangedAt`, but the `remindOverdue` self-transition rewrites `statusChangedAt`, so every reminder made the ticket look freshly touched.
problems.resolution: summarize() counts overdue from the ticket's immutable `createdAt` instead of `statusChangedAt`; `lastReminderAt` still throttles the reminder to one per ticket.

problems.title: Engineer and service-desk comments were recorded under the reporter scope
problems.symptom: An engineer could not comment on a ticket assigned to them, and the service desk could not comment on any ticket, although the employee could comment on their own.
problems.rootCause: The permission sets granted `comment` without naming a data scope, so the action fell back to its default (reporter) scope for every role.
problems.resolution: Grant `comment` with an explicit scope per role: engineer `{ tickets: assigned }`, service desk `{ tickets: allRecords }`, employee `{ tickets: reporter }`. Verified each role can comment on the tickets it may see.

problems.title: authz.require on a composite action always throws
problems.symptom: POST /tickets returned 403 PERMISSION_DENIED / AUTHORIZATION_DENIED for a caller whose role clearly granted create.
problems.rootCause: A composite action resolves to `effect: 'conditional'` (composeComposite in @nocobase/authorization); `authz.require(input)` throws AuthorizationDeniedError whenever `effect !== 'permit'`, and never accepts a conditional decision however valid the conditions are.
problems.resolution: HelpdeskService.create now calls `authz.authorize({ resource, action: 'create' })`, inspects `decision.effect`, and reads the row policy from `decision.conditions.database.tickets`, throwing AuthorizationDeniedError only when the policy is absent. Grep confirms no other `authz.require` remains. Documented in server/AGENTS.md.

problems.title: Client pages read the response envelope as the payload and rendered nothing
problems.symptom: Ticket detail and the dashboard rendered empty or crashed on `undefined` even though the API returned a populated JSON body; the network tab showed 200 with data.
problems.rootCause: ApiClient.request returns the full JSON envelope `{ data: ... }`, not the unwrapped value. The pages declared `.request<TicketOverview>()` and read the result as if it were the overview.
problems.resolution: Every caller destructures `{ data }` and the response type is wrapped (`request<{ data: T }>`): ticket detail, detail/actions.ts, new.tsx and home/index.tsx. tests/components/home.test.tsx mocks were updated to the envelope.

problems.title: Cookie-authenticated browser writes were rejected with INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN
problems.symptom: Submitting a ticket from the browser failed with 403 PERMISSION_DENIED reason INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN; reads and Bearer-token requests were unaffected, and the same request over curl failed for every local origin.
problems.rootCause: Better Auth's checkCookieWriteOrigin rejects a cookie-bearing write unless Origin/Referer is trusted, and trusted origins come from auth.trustedOrigins plus the base URL (APP_PUBLIC_ORIGIN). With neither configured the base URL is undefined and all browser writes fail closed.
problems.resolution: server/config/auth.ts now declares `trustedOrigins: (request) => [new URL(request.url).origin]` when no app.publicOrigin is set, so a directly served application trusts its own origin while still comparing the Origin header. Verified same-origin writes succeed and cross-site / origin-less writes still return 403.

problems.title: A read the caller lacks surfaced as 403 although only 404 was documented
problems.symptom: A denied ticket read returned 403 READ_FORBIDDEN instead of the bare 404 some callers expected, and the API document did not list 403 for the list, detail, comments or overview routes.
problems.rootCause: The visibility check binds a repository to the action policy; when the caller has no policy at all the repository throws READ_FORBIDDEN rather than yielding an empty result, so a missing permission is a 403 while a permitted-but-invisible row is a 404.
problems.resolution: Added 403 apiErrorResponse entries to GET /tickets, GET /tickets/:id, POST /tickets/:id/comments and GET /helpdesk/overview. Both statuses are now declared alongside 401/404.

problems.title: File-route guard leaked into unrelated contributions
problems.symptom: A guard meant for the ticket-attachment file routes was mounted at a broad path and would have applied to every contribution registered after it.
problems.rootCause: The file contribution was mounted without its own authentication, so the guard had to be installed before it — but a wildcard `router.use('*')` scopes to the whole router, not to the owned prefix.
problems.resolution: Mount `router.use('/ticketAttachments/*', auth.required())` on the exact prefix before the file routes, leaving the byte route public-by-uuid. Never use a router-wide wildcard from a contribution.

problems.title: Better Auth rate limit failed the third Playwright sign-in
problems.symptom: The employee Playwright test failed at sign-in because the suite signs in three users back to back and Better Auth rate-limits /api/auth/sign-in/email (three succeed, the fourth returns 429).
problems.rootCause: Better Auth applies a per-IP rate limit to the sign-in endpoint; a browser suite that logs in every test hits it.
problems.resolution: tests/playwright/helpdesk.test.ts retries a rate-limited sign-in after a wait. The retry is test-only and does not weaken the application's rate limiting.

problems.title: Application provider crashed when the runtime was composed without optional plugins
problems.symptom: tests/logic/app-server.test.ts failed: `registers application-owned providers and routes from the runtime` threw while resolving authorizationToken because it composes the runtime with `defineServerPlugins([])`; the embedded-runtime cases (`publishes whether sign-up is open`, `reads embedded runtime config`) threw `Collection "lifecycleEffectRuns" does not exist` because server/runtime.ts was started on a real database before the application migration ran.
problems.rootCause: The help-desk provider and route contributions were registered unconditionally and assumed the built-in authorization/authentication/file plugins and the help-desk tables were always present. The template deliberately builds the full runtime in tests with an empty plugin set and with a database that has no business migrations.
problems.resolution: HelpdeskProvider gained an `enabled` flag set only when authorizationToken is registered, and `start()` returns early unless `database.collections().get("tickets")` resolves. server/routes/helpdesk.ts and the attachmentGuard in server/routes/index.ts return an empty Hono router when the services they need are absent. All 28 app-server tests pass and the real application start is unchanged.

defects.title: Assign dialog reset a ticket priority to Medium
defects.symptom: Opening Assign on a Low-priority ticket showed Priority = Medium; confirming without touching the field silently wrote priority=medium back to the ticket.
defects.rootCause: TransitionDialog initialized priority with the literal "medium" and category with "" instead of reading the ticket it was acting on. lifecycle.assign always forwards priority, so the default always overwrote the stored value.
defects.resolution: TransitionsCard now passes the ticket into TransitionDialog, which initializes priority from ticket.priority and category from ticket.category ?? "". tests/components/ticket-detail.test.tsx asserts a Low/hardware ticket opens with Low and hardware.

defects.title: Assignee select showed the internal user id
defects.symptom: After choosing an engineer the Assign select displayed the raw user id (e.g. 391622638436354) rather than the engineer name.
defects.rootCause: The Base UI Select.Value renders the raw value unless the Root receives an items array of {value,label}. The tickets pages passed no items, so every select showed its value verbatim.
defects.resolution: Passed translated items to the assignee and priority selects in detail/index.tsx, the priority select in new.tsx, and the status filter in index.tsx. tests/components/ticket-detail.test.tsx selects Bob Li and asserts the trigger shows the name, not u-bob.

defects.title: Ticket list stayed stale after a transition
defects.symptom: After assign/resolve/confirm-close the detail page updated but the list rows kept the previous status until a full page reload.
defects.rootCause: /tickets/:id renders as a covering child of /tickets, so the list stays mounted behind RouteChildPage. The detail only reloaded itself; nothing told the list to re-fetch.
defects.resolution: TicketDetailPage reads the list reload from useOutletContext and calls it alongside its own re-fetch inside the combined reload. tests/components/ticket-detail.test.tsx asserts the outlet reload spy runs after a transition.

defects.title: Corrupt images uploaded and unsupported formats were silent
defects.symptom: A damaged corrupt.png uploaded, showed Done and could be submitted; unsupported.exe was ignored with no message.
defects.rootCause: new.tsx passed no onError, so FileUploadField accept rejection was swallowed. The accept check itself only compares name/type, so a mislabeled or corrupt file passed it and uploaded.
defects.resolution: FileUploadField gained a validateFile prop that runs before upload and reports a rejection through onError; new.tsx renders onError and validates content with isDecodableImage (signature + createImageBitmap decode) from the new pages/tickets/attachments.ts. tests/logic/ticket-attachments.test.ts and tests/components/file-upload-field.test.tsx cover it.
